characters.description: An Azarinth battle-healer traveling with Kyrian and Weavy. She treats the telepathic demon as an ally and is taking him and his new apprentice toward allies who may offer them a safer home.
characters.name: Ilea

characters.description: Ilea's metal-and-curse mage companion, traveling with her as she takes Weavy and his new apprentice toward a possible refuge.
characters.name: Kyrian

characters.description: A telepathic demon allied with Ilea. He wants a safer home away from frightened settlements and accepts an orphaned boy with an affinity for mind magic as his apprentice, helping the child control his emerging abilities.
characters.name: Weavy

characters.description: An orphaned village boy with an early affinity for mind magic. After learning that Weavy is a demon, he knowingly chooses to become Weavy's apprentice and receives help controlling his abilities.
characters.name: Weavy's apprentice

characters.description: Ilea’s sentient dagger companion.
characters.name: Aki

characters.description: Ilea's tactician and a team member who has taken a government position.
characters.name: Claire

characters.description: A Virilyan noble, lightning mage, and established member of Ilea's team.
characters.name: Trian

characters.description: A covert killer and investigator on Ilea's team whose location is unknown after the demon crisis.
characters.name: Eve

characters.description: A mage traveling with Edwin Redleaf while hunters from his house pursue them after an attack on a Redleaf training ground.
characters.name: Maria

characters.description: An elite Redleaf warrior traveling with Maria while hunters from his own house pursue them.
characters.name: Edwin Redleaf

characters.description: A survivor hidden beneath Trian's attacked estate. She is trained with a curved sword and commands the household's domesticated spider.
characters.name: Trian's younger sister

characters.description: A young member of Trian's household who survives in the concealed rooms beneath the estate and has basic mage abilities.
characters.name: Trian's adopted ward

characters.description: An adult survivor found badly injured by a resistant curse beneath Trian's estate. His body can store and extend a blade-like bone weapon.
characters.name: Trian's household protector

characters.description: A domesticated, scythe-legged spider guarding the survivors hidden beneath Trian's estate. It withdraws when Trian's younger sister commands it.
characters.name: Trian's household spider

characters.description: Edwin's sister, who reunites with Ilea near the Redleaf group's refuge. She recognizes Ilea from an earlier Taleen dungeon encounter and helps connect the two groups without continuing their initial fight.
characters.name: Felicia Redleaf

characters.description: A water mage traveling with Edwin Redleaf, Maria, and Felicia when their group first encounters Ilea's team.
characters.name: Aliana

characters.description: A wealthy and politically connected Redleaf member targeted by Edwin's alliance with Ilea's group. He is pursuing research intended to recreate Taleen teleportation gates, while Edwin initially withholds his personal reason for wanting him dead.
characters.name: Arthur Redleaf

characters.description: A House Birmingham member identified by the allied investigators as one of five people strongly implicated in the attack on Trian's household.
characters.name: Ronin Birmingham

characters.description: A House Birmingham member identified by the allied investigators as one of five people strongly implicated in the attack on Trian's household.
characters.name: Bale Birmingham

characters.description: A House Birmingham member identified by the allied investigators as one of five people strongly implicated in the attack on Trian's household.
characters.name: Graham Birmingham

characters.description: A House Birmingham member identified by the allied investigators as one of five people strongly implicated in the attack on Trian's household.
characters.name: Petra Birmingham

characters.description: A House Birmingham member identified by the allied investigators as one of five people strongly implicated in the attack on Trian's household.
characters.name: Wallace Birmingham

characters.description: A young Birmingham barrier mage encountered with Wallace during the raid on the family estate.
characters.name: Anya

characters.description: A young Birmingham healer and Anya's sister, encountered with Wallace during the raid on the family estate.
characters.name: Hera

characters.description: An unidentified white-haired wind mage wearing a mask. She kills several attackers during Virilya's evacuation, allowing soldiers and civilians to continue toward safety.
characters.name: Masked wind mage

characters.description: Trian's trusted contact in Virilya's Central District. She accepts his evidence against House Birmingham and undertakes to present it.
characters.name: Josephine Anderson

characters.description: A raven-commanding mercenary who fights with arm-mounted blades and is guarding Arthur Redleaf’s castle.
characters.name: Maurice

characters.description: A baker wearing heat-based armored equipment and serving among the mercenaries guarding Arthur Redleaf’s castle.
characters.name: Poppy

characters.description: A blind, white-armored mercenary swordfighter guarding Arthur Redleaf's castle. Her level is beyond Ilea's ability to identify, and she is intent on protecting the Taleen network.
characters.name: Blind mercenary

characters.description: Arthur Redleaf's necromancer hunter, able to transform into a powerful blood-monster. Maria kills him during the battle on the Isle of Gareth.
characters.name: Kyle

characters.description: Arthur Redleaf's ice-and-silver mage hunter. Ilea, Felicia, and Maurice pursue and kill her during the battle on the Isle of Gareth.
characters.name: Tiana

characters.description: A surviving enchanter from Arthur Redleaf's staff who explains the available Taleen gate evidence. He accepts recruitment to Ravenhall to research teleportation and help find Kyrian.
characters.name: Arthur Redleaf's enchanter

characters.description: Trian's surviving younger sister, reunited with him in a protected Ravenhall residence.
characters.name: Aurelia

characters.description: A surviving member of Trian's household who reunites with him in a protected Ravenhall residence.
characters.name: Samuel

characters.description: A surviving member of Trian's household who reunites with him in a protected Ravenhall residence.
characters.name: Orthon

characters.description: An apparent realm traveler whom Ilea regards as coming from the same place of origin as herself.
characters.name: Cless

characters.description: A solitary hooded elf encountered reading in the cathedral of an abandoned subterranean city.
characters.name: Hooded elf

characters.description: The hooded elf from the subterranean cathedral, now identified as a historian. He offers Ilea information in exchange for books, relics, and other materials recovered from the nearby dungeon.
characters.name: Elven historian

characters.description: A dwarf pilot who operates a metal war machine, guides Ilea through concealed tunnels to Hallowfort, and offers to introduce her to a smith.
characters.name: Dwarf pilot

characters.description: An Awakened, mist-bodied smith whose constant curse drains life from nearby visitors. He recognizes the ancient metal in Ilea’s recovered equipment and agrees to forge replacement armor from it while she heals through the curse.
characters.name: Awakened smith

characters.description: A dwarven scavenger and machine specialist who explores dangerous northern ruins in an upgraded war machine. He also works on locks and protective enchantments.
characters.name: Dwarven scavenger

characters.description: A cursed, mist-bodied Awakened smith who agrees to forge replacement armor for Ilea from ancient metal.
characters.name: Goliath

characters.description: A former Tremor guard captain whose translated service record preserves a view of the kingdom before its fall. His account describes royal affairs, changing dungeons, Soul Rippers, war, and the crisis that left Tremor as the last surviving city.
characters.name: Guard Captain Reyker

characters.description: Tremor's ancient mist-mage queen, found alive and confined within machinery beneath the palace after an apparently immense span of time.
characters.name: Ancient queen of Tremor

characters.description: A living captive bound into machinery beneath Tremor's palace, where his body supplies mana to the surrounding system.
characters.name: Captive man in Tremor's machinery

characters.description: Tremor's ancient king, a necromancer and the imprisoned queen's betrothed. His health and mana power the machinery and undead beneath the palace.
characters.name: Necromancer-king of Tremor

characters.description: A fox-like Awakened alchemist who owns the Hunter's Den in Hallowfort. She buys Blue Reaper remains and values their unusual organs, giving Ilea a reliable local buyer.
characters.name: Fox alchemist

characters.description: An unconscious but unharmed cat-like healer whom Ilea rescues from a swarm in the Descent.
characters.name: Feline healer

characters.description: A dwarf who operates a large armored war machine as part of a treasure-hunting group in the Descent.
characters.name: Baron

characters.description: A human ranger and expedition survivor who guides a treasure-hunting party through the Descent toward the Red Church complex.
characters.name: Austin

characters.description: An unnamed lizard warrior accompanying the rival treasure hunters who arrive in the Red Church experimentation area.
characters.name: Lizard warrior

characters.description: An insect-headed mage who leads the original owners of the treasure map used by Austin's party.
characters.name: Insect-headed mage-leader

characters.description: A small winged Fae found in a hidden cage within the Red Church's former experimentation complex. It protects itself with a magical barrier, and Ilea destroys the lock that has kept it imprisoned.
characters.name: Rescued Fae

characters.description: Three elven hunters found being overwhelmed by Taleen Centurions. Ilea intervenes and draws the machines away while her dwarf companion moves the hunters out of immediate danger.
characters.name: Young elven hunters

characters.description: A powerful death spirit that occupied the mansion of the ancient necromancer king's friend after killing him. Ilea destroys the spirit during the search for the king's treasury key.
characters.name: Undying Lord

characters.description: An elder of Ilea's organization who withdrew from its broader affairs to study the North's ecological collapse and attempt restoration. He cannot explain Adam Strand's motive for causing the demon crisis.
characters.name: Organization elder

characters.description: The person an elder of Ilea’s organization identifies as responsible for the demon crisis. His reason for causing it remains unknown.
characters.name: Adam Strand
